summary: Tested LocaleLanguageNudge on Marketing console + Marketing tab i18n sanity. Backend endpoints GET/PUT /api/org/localization verified via curl for FR (EUR/fr-FR/TVA 20%), DE (EUR/de-DE/MwSt 19%), and reset to GB. Frontend: nudge appears at top of /marketing when org currency != EUR and UI language is FR or DE; dismiss persists via localStorage; apply switches org localization to EUR and triggers reload. No mkt.* i18n key leaks found on Start tab in en/fr/de. Org left on GB/GBP after cleanup.
critical_code_review_comments: Nudge language resolution relies on i18n.resolvedLanguage. In this run, the demo owner's stored preferred language was 'de'; even with ?lng=fr in the URL and localStorage i18nextLng='fr' set after login, the app resolved to 'de'. Not a nudge bug, but note the language detector isn't honouring ?lng=fr for authenticated users (server-side user language wins).
The nudge dismissKey (locale_nudge_dismissed_${lng}) is per-language: if a user toggles between fr and de, they'll see the nudge twice. Acceptable, but worth documenting.
seed_data_creation: None. Org localization mutated during test then reset to GB/GBP.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Marketing console at /marketing renders <LocaleLanguageNudge/> from /app/frontend/src/pages/MarketingSuite.js. Nudge only fires when GET /api/org/localization returns can_edit=true, currency!=EUR, country_code!=target. Owner user language was 'de' in the DB during this run, which prevented forcing FR via query/localStorage — main agent can change user's preferred_language via profile if pure-FR UX test is required. Verified: DE branch text, dismiss-persist-reload, apply→EUR reload, EUR-hides-banner, no mkt.* leaks in en/fr/de on Start tab.
